public_family_candidate: content-addressed build/action cache keyed by declared inputs

fatal_gates.F1: prior evidence and scope records remain immutable; reuse creates no new semantic credit
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted build/cache service, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 every reusable evidence record declares a bounded dependency set drawn from fixed scope dimensions
G2 dependency declaration is sealed before observing the later scope change
G3 changed dimensions are represented as an exact set rather than inferred from prose similarity
G4 reuse is allowed only when evidence_dependencies intersect changed_dimensions is empty
G5 any nonempty intersection forces current-scope re-evaluation before ranking, switching, or aspiration
G6 reused unaffected evidence retains its original credit identity and cannot be credited again
G7 a re-evaluated affected record is stored as a new scope-qualified record; prior record remains immutable history
G8 undeclared or wildcard dependencies default to affected and require re-evaluation
G9 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and stale completions are scope-fenced
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier and terminal readback before any new credit

candidate_patterns.pattern: reuse every old record if its candidate id still exists
invalidate and re-evaluate every old record after any scope change
reuse E1 because its declared dependencies are disjoint; re-evaluate E2 because task_data changed; re-evaluate E3 because dependencies are undeclared
delegate dependency tracking/cache validity to an external hosted build service

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify dimensions, dependencies, or guards after public source read.
credit_rule: No credit for cache-style reuse. At most one leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native dependency gate passes the fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read primary/official public sources for content-addressed action caching keyed by declared inputs, bind only source-supported dependency/key invalidation semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute PR-A..PR-D against this fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence.
